_comment: spinup's suggested skills for Claude Code + Codex. Your first `spinup skills add|remove|manual|auto` copies this list to your library (~/.spinup/skills.json), which is used from then on. Keep the list small: every auto-triggered skill's description costs tokens in every session. Stack-specific skills go per repo (per-repo.json). `manual`: installed, but only run when called (/name, $name).
